C0632.title: Temu Cracks Down on Duplicate Listings
C0632.summary: Temu is intensifying enforcement against duplicate product listings. Violations can lead to delisting, temporary bans on new product uploads, long-term caps on active inventory, and even permanent store closure, directly disrupting merchants' normal operations.

references.title: Permanent store closure in two days! Temu is cracking down on duplicate listings...
